summary:
Frontend-only regression test of BERSINAR POS after the performance/zero-animation refactor (memoized ProductCard/CartItem, 150ms debounced search, lazy render 24/page, localStorage product cache, zero-animation modals/sheets). Verified on desktop 1920x1080 with admin login. All data-testids intact; no console errors; no behavioral regressions.

Tested and PASSED: admin login -> POS; 12 seeded products render; cat-Sayur filter instant (3 products); debounced search 'minyak' -> 1 product; non-decimal 'Minyak Goreng 2L' click adds qty 1 and increments on repeat click (cart-total Rp 76.000 after x2); decimal 'Bayam Hijau' click opens numpad-overlay instantly with decimal '.' key present; numpad-key-5 sets display and numpad-confirm button bounding box (y=776, h=60) fits fully inside the 1080-tall viewport (NOT cut off); confirm applies Grosir tier at Rp 10.000/Kg (cart item: 'Bayam Hijau Rp 10.000/Kg Grosir 5 Rp 50.000'); cart-inc/dec on decimal item steps 0.25 (5 -> 5.25 -> 5); cart-qty-<id> reopens numpad with initial=5; cart-remove works; cart-clear implicit after checkout; Cash checkout: checkout-modal shows checkout-grand Rp 114.000, checkout-paid 500.000 -> checkout-change Rp 386.000, pay-Cash + checkout-confirm creates transaction and receipt-modal appears with receipt-print-btn and receipt-wa-btn, success toast 'Transaksi berhasil!'; after checkout, cart cleared (0 items) and background product stock badge refreshed (Minyak Goreng 2L: 43 PCS -> 40 PCS after selling 3, then -> 39 PCS after an additional credit sale of 1); Credit checkout: pay-Credit + checkout-customer select (3 B2B customers listed) + valid small-amount credit sale -> receipt shown successfully.

Not re-verified in this iteration (unchanged from iteration_1 and backend-covered): credit over-limit blocking (iteration_1 confirmed it works; attempt here was blocked earlier by stock-cap on Daging Sapi 12 Kg so could not force a >credit_limit cart); kasir role gating. Backend untouched per request.

issues: Hard-coded demo credentials still shown below the Masuk button ('Admin: ... / bersinar123, Kasir: ... / kasir123'). Should be removed before production.
Seed still reuses the same 'rice bag' image for most non-vegetable products (Air Mineral, Teh Botol, Gula, Minyak, Beras). Pre-existing from iteration_1.

critical_code_review_comments: POS.js is now ~490 LOC and includes CheckoutModal inline — consider extracting CheckoutModal into its own file to keep POS.js focused on catalog/cart.

localStorage PRODUCTS_CACHE is written on every /products fetch but never invalidated by version; if seed/schema changes, stale cache may hydrate incompatible objects. Consider adding a schema version key or clear-on-logout.
resolvePrice runs inside CartItem on every render and again inside cartTotal useMemo; acceptable for 12 products but worth memoizing by (product.id, qty) if cart grows.
test_credentials: Admin: citerxciter.citer@gmail.com / bersinar123 ; Kasir: kasir@bersinar.id / kasir123
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (12 products, 3 B2B customers, 3 locations). Two live sales were created during testing (1 Cash Rp 114.000 for Minyak Goreng x3; 1 Credit for Minyak Goreng x1) — stock on Minyak dropped 43 -> 39 PCS. No cleanup; transactional data by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App renders POS at the root path '/' (not '/pos'); use wait_for_selector('[data-testid^="product-"]') after login instead of wait_for_url. Receipt modal (data-testid=receipt-modal) has a close X button at the top-right (first svg-button inside the modal) — selector 'xpath=//*[@data-testid="receipt-modal"]//button[.//svg][1]' or page.click('[data-testid="receipt-modal"] button:has(svg)') works. Numpad '.' key testid is 'numpad-key-dot'. Decimal product step for +/- is 0.25. Grosir tier for Bayam Hijau triggers at qty>=5 (price 10.000). All iteration_1 data-testids are preserved.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs. Refactor validated green.
